limitations: Class-disjoint query evaluation on synthetic GroceryStoreDataset crops; not shop photos.
Exact cosine voting; production HNSW recall is not measured.
Per-observation counts share source photos and are correlated.
Duplicate queries exclude their source photo and all its augmentations.
Duplicate candidates use disjoint gallery halves; no held class images fit thresholds.
Neither 95 nor 97 fit policy meets its precision target on held classes.
Quantization crop timing overlaps background checks; use separate idle embed_bench results for artifact latency.
C2 real-shop accuracy and C3 end-to-end device/WAN latency are not validated.
policy: 95 percent fit precision; floor retaining at least 95 percent known fit queries; duplicate fit precision 97 percent
policy_validation_note: 95 percent policy requested after initial 97 report; held half reused for descriptive comparison, not a new confirmatory test

quantization_decision.reason: 19.0171-point top1 loss exceeds the strict 1.5-point adoption limit

startup_ram.settings: 4 threads each, all pinned SAM/OCR models, no DB/Redis/storage clients or requests

cargo_test.model_weights: absent from default test environment; real-model gate run separately

real_model_release.note: Two SAM timing tests exceeded budgets during concurrent eval; idle rerun passed at unchanged budgets
